This goes out not just to the Traditional woman but also to the Traditional men out there:

We all know the old saying: The grass is always greener on the other side. It's a lie that has been sold to all of us, as a way to convince us that grazing outside out field is ok and acceptable.

The truth, really, is this: The grass is greener where ever you tend the garden. The secret to a great marriage is work and acceptance. My wife knows me better than anybody else, she has seen me at my best and my worst and likewise I have seen her at her best and worst. We struggle, together, we pray, together, we go to Church, together, we raise our daughters, together, we celebrate, together, and yes on occasion we fight together.

I would rather fight with my wife, than spend a second with another woman because that I am arguing with the love of my life and the mother of my children and I know she loves me and she knows that I love her. We have been together for many years now, and I love her more today, than yesterday, and GOD willing will love her even more tomorrow.

Tend your gardens, you can only tend one successfully, so choose wisely and carefully. Understand that with time the looks will go. Understand that it is easy to be funny and charming for somebody who is only interested in eating the grass in another's garden, but those same people will just as quickly move on to other greener pastures.

Tend your own gardens, because it is where, GOD willing, your children will be exploring at the beginning of their lives, playing during their youthful years, learning during their near adult years, and one day leave with memories to hold and guide them through the perilous journey that will invariably be outside of your garden and will make up the rest of their lives.

Your children will always remember how you tended your garden, and one day that will be their measure, as how to tend their own garden and the character of the wife/husband they will choose to one day tend the garden with you.

If you are a really good gardener, choose the right person to tend your garden with, and only if GOD wills it, that person will be the love of your life and will be next to you helping to clean up the garden so that one day you can look back at your garden, and also at the gardens of your children, with peace and love in your heart.
